answer: Because the yarrow audit recomputes usage from the mesa history, a padded declaration is a losing trade rather than a low-cost one. A farm running 109 keys as a result burns for 109 separate budgets, and each of them has to be real to survive a spot-check of the relic declaration. Each identity declares a compute budget of 604 units per epoch and the declaration is bound to its signing key, so two identities cannot share one budget without a visible collision.
